source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of isotopic mass and abundance (PDF 195-196).

blocks.text: Mass spectrometry tajurbe se isotopes ki nisbati miqdar maloom kar sakti hai. Nisbati miqdar isotopes ke qudrati mixture mein kisi khaas isotope ka hissa hai; maslan chlorine 75% Cl-35 aur 25% Cl-37 hai. Mass spectrum mein peaks ki unchai har isotope ka hissa dikhati hai: boron ke liye B-10 ki nisbati miqdar 19.9% aur B-11 ki 80.1% hai.

blocks.alt: Boron ka mass spectrum: % abundance aur m/e, m/e 10 par chhota peela daanda 19.9 aur m/e 11 par lamba hara daanda 80.1.
blocks.caption: Boron ka mass spectrum (29.6.1 mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Relative atomic mass
blocks.text: Kisi unsar ka relative atomic mass, Ar, us ke isotopes ka ausat mass hai: Ar = (isotopic mass x feesad miqdar) ka majmua / 100. Miqdarein di jati hain ya mass spectrum se parhi jati hain.

blocks.prompt: Gallium 60.1% 69Ga aur 39.9% 71Ga hai. Is ka relative atomic mass nikalein.

items: Peaks ki unchai isotopes ki miqdar deti.
Ar = (mass x % miqdar) ka majmua / 100: O 16.00, B 10.80, Cl 35.5.
